about: The two models this tool runs, both pinned: GigaAM by the SHA-256 of its files, the Hugging Face model by a commit. Change models here.
checked: 2026-11-27: GigaAM Multilingual-v2 and GigaAM-v4 (both released that day) against the Qwen3-ASR + Granite Speech pair of 0.x. English: 117 chunks, 24 minutes of speech from two public interviews; of the 4603 words Qwen3-ASR and Granite both wrote, the Multilingual-v2 reading with the tag «ru-en» did not have 3.5 % (its plain reading 2.7 %), with «auto» 5.2 %, GigaAM-v4 4.1 % (3.1 %). Russian: 110 chunks of two studio recordings; the words of Multilingual-v2 «ru-en» differed from the Qwen3-ASR reading in 8.8 % and 10.7 % of cases, GigaAM-v4 in 9.9 % and 11.0 %. An English sentence inside one of the Russian recordings: «ru-en» exact, «ru» empty. Nobody listened to any recording, so these are not error rates
review_every: 3 months: re-read the model cards and leaderboards

asr.why: chosen over GigaAM-v4: one model for Russian and English that reads them a little closer to the references (see «checked»), three times the download. «language» is the tag the model gets: a mix of Russian and English, so English names inside Russian speech come out in Latin. 776M params; punctuation, casing and digits built in. On an i9-14900K it read 8.9 minutes of speech in 37 s, the same as an RTX 4080

speakers.why: who spoke when, up to 8 speakers, open weights, 100M params; a few seconds on a processor for a 10-minute recording
